import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Normalize island values (strip whitespace)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Handle out-of-range body_mass_g values (set to NaN if outside 2500-6500)
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = np.nan
    
    # Handle negative/out-of-range flipper_length_mm values (set to NaN if outside 170-235)
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = np.nan
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and calculate mean body_mass_g
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
